name: Wenikee Boltbucket
label: Quest
description: Having tinkered with the retrieved samophlange until it broke, the goblin engineer Sputtervalve needs an expert hand to restore it before his colleagues…
intro: Having tinkered with the retrieved samophlange until it broke, the goblin engineer Sputtervalve needs an expert hand to restore it before his colleagues in Undermine demand results. He sends adventurers north across the Barrens to consult Wenikee Boltbucket, a clever tinkerer stationed near the Mor'shan Rampart.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I think I might have broken that Samophlange. That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued. We must find a way to fix it!

Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale. She is very clever and inquisitive. If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm very busy with my work, adventurer. Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, what's this? A samophlange, you say? What's a samophlange??
Ah... But look at the way it moves when you handle it. And there's the sound of intricate gears inside. Oh my! I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
